policy.queueAuthorityNote: CORRECTED 2026-10-12. This previously read 'V5_WORKSTREAM_REGISTRY_AND_MASTER_REMEDIATION_WAVES'. No V5_WORKSTREAM_REGISTRY exists: it is not a tracked file and no document in docs/ carries that title. The three documents named above do exist and are what the tasks below actually cite.
policy.requireAttestedIdentityNote: Left false deliberately. No runner exists to mint identity tokens, so enabling it would block all verification. Turn it on when a runner holds SKILLS_AGENT_ATTESTATION_KEY out of worker reach.
policy.inventoryScopeNote: This queue is NOT a per-finding enumeration of the registry's 319 canonical rows. The registry states of itself that 'the P1-P3 register carries no per-row status field, so its movement is not mechanically countable', so a row-by-row queue cannot be derived from it without inventing statuses. The tasks below are the items for which direct repository evidence exists. V5-REC-002 records the remaining enumeration as the registry's own deferred row-by-row pass.
